fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.33.7 keeps the validated PPA synchronization from v0.33.3 and extends the OCum proxy diagnostic to inspect the actual NiSkinInstance binding of Body [Ovl0]: skin root, matrix count and sampled bones are compared against the actor's live scene graph so stale STR skeleton bindings can be distinguished from ordinary RaceMenu geometry/material problems.
